blocks.content: When fractions share the same bottom number, adding and subtracting them is simple — you only work with the tops.
To add fractions with the same bottom (denominator), add the top numbers and keep the bottom the same.

blocks.explain: Add the tops (1 + 2 = 3) and keep the bottom 5: 3/5.
blocks.rule: To add fractions with the same bottom, add the tops and keep the bottom.

blocks.content: To subtract fractions with the same bottom, subtract the top numbers and keep the bottom the same.

blocks.explain: Subtract the tops (5 - 2 = 3) and keep the bottom 8: 3/8.
blocks.rule: To subtract fractions with the same bottom, subtract the tops and keep the bottom.

blocks.content: Same bottom? Just add or subtract the tops and keep the bottom. Let's practise!
